purpose: Prove that the priority NEE AI questions are evaluated as evidence-bound candidate-answer contracts rather than ungrounded recommendations.
proven_cases: AI-PDLC POV can proceed only as a source-linked candidate answer when current project evidence and source-bound counterevidence are available.
AI productivity metrics can proceed as a candidate answer with an explicit counterevidence gap; they are never promoted to a fact or KPI commitment.
Agentic-readiness questions use the same time, evidence, and audience boundaries.
Missing required status returns NO_ANSWER rather than a fabricated recommendation.
Conflicting status or untrusted evidence returns NO_ANSWER.
Candidate answer sections are explicit and cannot be silently broadened.

active_graph.posture: Use cases remain declarative candidate-answer contracts. W12 approval-bound migration remains the only path to target-graph mutation.

next_step: The source-bound retrieval connector projects candidate outlines directly; no human-review, draft-ledger, or provider-preflight stage is required.
